不管时笙怎么抗拒，最终她还是带着几朵花骨朵上节目了。

这个组合一共四个人，两男两女，这样的组合很少见，主要是路子不宽，所以在决定打造这样的组合的时候，公司也是考虑了很久。

好在这四人的底子很好，主要是长得好。

训练了一段时间，默契也不错，所以公司最终还是同意了这个方案。

“小晚，你来了。诶……小晚带了新人？”接小晚的是节目组的林导演，看到她身后四个嫩得冒水的少女少年，顿时眼前一亮。

这四人长得可不是一般的漂亮。

“嗯，带他们亮个相。”时笙点了点头，给双方介绍了一下，“这是林导演，韩灵，方瑾瑜，言泽，姜明。”

“林导演好。”四人乖巧的问好。

“好好，正好，正好。”林导演笑呵呵的连连点头。

他刚才还在愁去哪儿找长得漂亮的少年们，没想到这就送上门了，江晚简直就是他的福星，瞌睡来了送枕头。

他们这档节目叫《极限世界》，挑战节目组设下的各种任务，这些任务不说有多难，但是绝对很奇葩。

第一季收视率并不好，导演咬牙做了第二季，又花大价钱请了长得好看的几个明星，第二季迅速窜红。

现在是第三季，前面已经录了两期，这是第三期。

这期节目需要两个少年，少年还需要长得特别的水灵好看。

本来已经联系好了，谁知道人现在来不来了，马上就出发了，短的时间让他去哪儿找人？

就算后面还有时间，要找符合条件的人，也是个难题。

虽然时笙带了四个，但是他只需要改改剧本就好了，而且那两个少女也很漂亮啊！

“这次我们拍摄的目的地在南山，等人到齐了咱们就出发。”林导演笑眯眯的看着时笙后面的四只，满意得胡子都快翘起来了。

林导演给时笙和四只安排了一个车，又匆匆的走了。

“晚姐……这节目我们看了，会不会特别的难玩儿？”四人中，胆子最大的韩灵靠着时笙坐着，忐忑的问了一句。

另外三人也紧张的看着时笙。

他们之前都在训练，还从来没有上过节目。

“当然难玩。”时笙理所当然的点点头。

不难玩，节目组的收视率要不要？

本宝宝为了玩儿转这个节目，可是很认真的看了攻略的——虽然没有卵用。

四人顿时垮了脸，那他们不是要出丑了？

“你们担心做什么？你们最多是任务中的角色，又不是让你们去挑战，别想太多。”

No matter how much Shi Sheng resisted, she finally went on the show with a few flowers.

There are a total of four people in this combination, two men and two women. Such a combination is rare, mainly because the road is not wide, so when deciding to create such a combination, the company also considered it for a long time.

Fortunately, these four people have a good foundation, mainly because they are good-looking.

After training for a while, the tacit understanding was good, so the company finally agreed to this plan.

"Xiao Wan, you're here. Hey...Xiao Wan has brought a newcomer?" The person who picked up Xiao Wan was Director Lin from the program team. When he saw the four tender girls and teenagers behind her, his eyes suddenly lit up.

These four people are not ordinary beautiful.

"Well, show them off." Shi Sheng nodded and introduced both parties, "This is Director Lin, Han Ling, Fang Jinyu, Yan Ze, and Jiang Ming."

"Hello, Director Lin." The four of them greeted obediently.

"Okay, just right, just right." Director Lin nodded repeatedly with a smile.

Just now he was worried about where to find beautiful young people, but he didn't expect that they would be delivered to his door. Jiang Wan was simply his lucky star, and he would give him a pillow when he felt sleepy.

Their program is called "Extreme World", which challenges various tasks set by the program team. Not to mention how difficult these tasks are, they are definitely very weird.

The ratings of the first season were not good, so the director gritted his teeth and made the second season, and spent a lot of money to hire some good-looking celebrities. The second season quickly became popular.

It is now the third season. Two episodes have been recorded before, and this is the third episode.

This program requires two teenagers, and the teenager needs to be particularly good-looking.

He had already been contacted, but who knew if the person would come now, he was about to leave. Where could he go to find someone in such a short period of time?

Even if there is still time later, it is still a problem to find people who meet the conditions.

Although Shi Sheng brought four, he only needed to change the script, and the two girls were also very beautiful!

"The destination of our shooting this time is Nanshan. We will set off when everyone is here." Director Lin looked at the four behind Shi Sheng with a smile, and his beard almost stood up with satisfaction.

Director Lin arranged a car for Shi Sheng and Si Zhi and left in a hurry.

"Sister Wan...we watched this show, will it be particularly difficult to watch?" Han Ling, the boldest among the four, asked anxiously as he sat leaning against Shi Sheng.

The other three people also looked at Shi Sheng nervously.

They have all been training before and have never been on a show.

"Of course it's hard to play." Shi Sheng nodded matter-of-factly.

It’s not difficult to play. Do you want the ratings of the program team?

I watched this program just to have fun, but I read the guide carefully - even though it was useless.

The four people's faces suddenly fell. Are they going to make a fool of themselves?

"What are you worried about? You are just a role in the mission at most, and I don't ask you to challenge it. Don't think too much."
